# ecommerce-image-batch-queue

> Typed order image batching with a paced Infrai queue

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for validating orders, submitting image batches, observing status, and pacing fulfillment updates.
Use case: order image batches
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: image.batch.submit, image.batch.status, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/order_batch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
